construction: Use zeta=exp(2*pi*i/L), L=lcm(segments,2*stacks,4); original coordinates scaled by 4/radius are integer polynomials in zeta. Monic division by Phi_L uses integer coefficients only.
zero_rule: A zero polynomial remainder certifies the exact determinant is zero.
nonzero_anchor_rule: Phi_L is the minimal polynomial of a primitive L-th root in characteristic zero. Therefore a nonzero reduced normal component certifies a nondegenerate anchor plane; only then may all original points with zero determinant be grouped.

normative_mathematical_sources.role: Cyclotomic product and monic polynomial identities supporting recursive construction.
Cyclotomic polynomial equals the minimal polynomial of a primitive root; irreducibility over the rationals.

verification_limits: These primary theorem references justify the mathematics; they do not mean the local Python oracle has been formally verified in Lean.
Integer arithmetic and exact remainders are used throughout. No floating threshold participates in admission of a group.
Only the fixed original fixtures are covered by this diagnostic. General scalar eligibility, cost bounds and native proof retention remain future work.
